```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(magrittr)
library(tidyverse)
library(rlang)
library(cmdstanr)
library(loo)
library(posterior)
library(tidybayes)
library(bayesplot)
library(here)
library(targets)
library(colorspace)

# Using different temp directories on SCP and locally.
tmp_dir <- if (nchar(Sys.getenv("TMP")) > 0) file.path(Sys.getenv("TMPDIR"), "adc-early-predict") else here("temp")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache.path = file.path("/wscratch", Sys.getenv("USER"), "adc-early-predict/cache/"))

ggplot2::theme_set(theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial"))

source(here("r", "util.R"))
source(here("r", "crcr.R"))

tar_config_set(store = file.path(tmp_dir, "_targets"), script = here("_targets.R"))
```

# Model

## Confirmed Response Competing Risks Model

First, we have a competing risks model of time-to-classification, with a separate hazard function per risk (confirmed response vs confirmed non-response).

$$
\lambda_r(t;\boldsymbol{x,\theta}_r) = \lambda_{rt}\exp(\boldsymbol{x\beta}_r),\,r \in \{\textrm{responder, non-responder}\} 
$$
The conditional probability of classification as a responder or non-responder (exiting the state of being unclassified) is

$$
\begin{align}
\Pr[Y_{rt} = 1 \mid Y_{r,t-1} = 0, \boldsymbol{x, \beta}_r] &= 1 - \exp[-\lambda_r(t;\boldsymbol{x,\beta}_r)] \\
\Pr[Y_{rt} = 1 \mid Y_{r,t-1} = 1, \boldsymbol{x, \beta}_r] &= 1 \\
\end{align}
$$

```{r}
#| label: conf-resp-hazard-ratio
#| cache: true

hb <- seq(0, 3, by = 0.1)

bind_rows(
  prior = tar_read("prior_crcr_hazard_ratio"),
  post = tar_read("crcr_hazard_ratio"),
  .id = "fit_type"
) |> 
  group_by(trial, k, fit_type) |> 
  reframe(t = hb[-1], bindist = rvar_sample_hist(patient_crcr_hazard_ratio, hb)) |> 
  mutate(k = factor(k, levels = 1:2, labels = c("Response", "Non-response"))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(t)) +
  stat_lineribbon(aes(ydist = bindist, color = fit_type, fill = fit_type, alpha = fit_type),
                  linewidth = 1,
                  step = "vh",
                  .width = c(0.5, 0.8)) +
  scale_color_discrete("", label = str_to_title, type = AZ_palette, aesthetic = c("color", "fill")) +
  scale_alpha_manual("", values = c(prior = 0.05, post = 0.25)) +
  facet_grid(vars(trial), vars(k), scales = "free_y") +
  guides(alpha = "none") +
  NULL
```

covar_param <- lst(prior = prior_confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res, post = confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res) |>

```{r}

conf_resp_cif <- lst(prior = prior_confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res, post = confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res) |> 
  map_dfr(get_conf_resp_cif, .id = "fit_type") 

conf_resp_prob_confirmed <- conf_resp_cif |> 
  group_by(fit_type, trial, i, k) |> 
  filter(min_rank(t) == n()) |> 
  group_by(fit_type, trial, i) |> 
  mutate(cif = cif / rvar_sum(cif)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(k == 2)

conf_resp_cif |> 
  filter(trial == "Breast04", i <= 5) |>
  mutate(k = factor(k, levels = 1:2, labels = c("Response", "Non-response"))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(t)) +
  stat_lineribbon(aes(ydist = cif, color = fit_type, fill = fit_type), alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 2, .width = c(0.5, 0.8)) +
  scale_color_discrete(type = AZ_palette, aesthetics = c("color", "fill")) +
  facet_grid(vars(i), vars(k))
```

```{r}
conf_resp_prob <- lst(prior = prior_confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res, post = confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res) |> 
  map_dfr(get_conf_resp_prob, .id = "fit_type") 
```

```{r}
tar_load("confirmed_resp_pfs_res")

hb <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)

cif <- confirmed_resp_pfs_res$fit[[2]] |> 
  spread_rvars(cif[i, t, k])

cif2 <- xx |>  
  spread_rvars(cif[i, t, k])

cif2 |>
  mutate(fit_type = "posterior") |> 
  filter(t %in% seq(1, 100, 10)) |> 
  group_by(fit_type, t, k) |> 
  reframe(p = hb[-1], bindist = rvar_sample_hist(cif, hb)) |> 
  mutate(k = factor(k, levels = 1:2, labels = c("Non-response", "Response"))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(p)) +
  stat_lineribbon(aes(ydist = bindist, color = fit_type, fill = fit_type, alpha = fit_type),
                  linewidth = 1,
                  step = "vh",
                  .width = c(0.5, 0.8)) +
  scale_color_discrete("", label = str_to_title, type = AZ_palette, aesthetic = c("color", "fill")) +
  scale_alpha_manual("", values = c(prior = 0.125, posterior = 0.25)) +
  # labs(x = "Hazard Ratio", y = "Density") +
  scale_y_continuous("", breaks = NULL) +
  facet_grid(vars(t), vars(k), scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  guides(alpha = "none") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0), strip.placement = "outside") +
  NULL
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-pfs-conf-resp-boostrap
#| fig-width: 10 
#| fig-height: 8

pfs_conf_resp_bootstrap_median_pfs |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = b)) +
  # stat_lineribbon(aes(ydist = bootstrap_median_pfs, color = "Bootstrap", fill = "Bootstrap"), alpha = 0.25, .width = 0.8) +
  geom_lineribbon(aes(y = bootstrap_median_pfs, ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper, color = "Bootstrap", fill = "Bootstrap"), alpha = 0.25) +
  stat_pointinterval(aes(ydist = sim_median_pfs, color = "Full Data"),
  .width = 0.8,
  data = pfs_cr_median_pfs |> filter(fct_match(fit_type, "posterior")) |> mutate(b = 0)) +
  # geom_text(aes(x = 175, y = 25, label = str_c("n = ", n)), data = \(d) distinct(d, trial, prediction_week, n)) +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c(AZ_platinum, AZ_plum), aesthetics = c("color", "fill")) +
  scale_x_continuous("Simulation", breaks = NULL, labels = NULL) +
  labs(y = "Median PFS [Weeks]", caption = "200 bootstrap simulations per panel.") +
  facet_grid(
    vars(trial), vars(prediction_week, n), 
    scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(prediction_week = \(w) str_c("Week ", w), n = \(n) str_c("n = ", n)), switch = "y", 
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0), strip.placement = "outside") +
  NULL
```
